targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(energy_used_kwh)*1000/NULLIF(SUM(distance_km),0))::numeric), 0) FROM daily_mileage WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND distance_km > 0 AND $__timeFilter(date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(energy_used_kwh)::numeric, 1), 0) FROM daily_mileage WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(distance_km)::numeric), 0) FROM daily_mileage WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(date)

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(cs.cost)*100/NULLIF(SUM(dm.distance_km),0))::numeric, 2), 0) FROM daily_mileage dm LEFT JOIN charging_sessions cs ON cs.vehicle_id = dm.vehicle_id AND DATE(cs.start_time) = dm.date WHERE dm.vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(dm.date)

SELECT date AS time, ROUND((energy_used_kwh*1000/NULLIF(distance_km,0))::numeric) AS efficiency FROM daily_mileage WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND distance_km > 0 AND $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date
SELECT d.start_date AS time, d.speed_max FROM drives d WHERE d.vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND d.distance > 0 AND d.speed_max > 0 AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) ORDER BY d.start_date

SELECT p.created_at AS time, p.outside_temp, ROUND((d.distance / NULLIF(ABS(d.start_battery_level - d.end_battery_level), 0) * 100)::numeric) AS efficiency FROM drives d JOIN positions p ON p.vehicle_id = d.vehicle_id AND p.created_at BETWEEN d.start_date AND COALESCE(d.end_date, NOW()) WHERE d.vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND d.distance > 5 AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) ORDER BY p.created_at

list.name: vehicle_id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, COALESCE(display_name, vin) AS __text FROM vehicles ORDER BY id
